whenToUse: Buyer is defined by job function, seniority, or company attributes (not demographics or interests)
Average customer value (LTV or first-year contract) exceeds $5,000-$10,000
Sales cycle is longer than 30 days and involves multiple stakeholders
Targeting account-based marketing (ABM) lists or specific industries
Offer is professional, educational, or career-relevant in nature
whenNotToUse: Selling B2C products with low order values
Audience is defined by lifestyle, hobbies, or consumer behavior
You need same-day or same-week conversions at scale
Budget is below $5,000/month — LinkedIn's auction punishes underfunded accounts
Offer requires high-frequency creative refreshes (LinkedIn audiences saturate slowly but creative fatigue sets in fast)
_universal.ruleOfThumb: If you wouldn't pay a recruiter to find this exact person, LinkedIn is probably not your channel. The platform's value is precision targeting on professional identity — pay for that, or pay for something else.

brandAwareness.why: Need impression volume to be statistically meaningful

websiteVisits.why: Need clicks to test creative & landing pages

leadGeneration.why: Need 15+ conversions/week for algorithm to optimize

websiteConversions.why: Higher CPL; needs more budget headroom

abmConversation.why: Capped delivery; budget constrained by audience size

audienceSizeRules.abm: as small as 5,000 if list is high-quality

copyFrameworks.name: PAS — Problem / Agitation / Solution
copyFrameworks.bestFor: Established pain points where the buyer already knows they have a problem

copyFrameworks.name: BAB — Before / After / Bridge
copyFrameworks.bestFor: Transformation stories — paint the current state, the future state, and how the offer bridges them

copyFrameworks.name: Insight-Led
copyFrameworks.bestFor: Open with a counterintuitive data point or pattern observation. Best for thought leadership and challenger sales

creativeRules: Stop the scroll in the first 1.3 seconds — image or first frame must do the entire job alone
Faces outperform product shots in 70% of B2B tests
Text overlay: 6 words or fewer, high-contrast, top-third placement
Video: caption everything (85% of viewing happens with sound off)
Avoid LinkedIn's stock photo aesthetic — desaturated grays and handshakes look like every other ad
Refresh creative every 2-3 weeks — audiences saturate slowly but creative fatigue is real
Always run 3-5 creative variants per campaign — single-creative campaigns hide their own performance ceiling
Never open with 'Are you a [job title]?' — the algorithm suppresses these and CTR drops 30-40%
preLaunchChecklist: Insight Tag installed and verified active
Conversion events defined with monetary values
Customer list and employee list uploaded as suppression
Audience Expansion DISABLED on all campaigns
Lead Gen Forms tested with real submission
Frequency caps configured (3-5 per week per audience)
Client briefed on Day 1-14 learning phase expectations

commonPitfalls.fix: Drop one targeting facet at a time until audience is 50K+
Disable Audience Expansion; layer in more facets
Match copy promise to landing page hero — clickbait headlines kill conversion

commonPitfalls.pitfall: CPL fine but lead quality poor
commonPitfalls.fix: Tighten seniority targeting; add suppression lists
Audience too small for budget — expand audience or reduce daily spend
Hands-off for 14 days, then optimize. Multiple changes early wreck the algorithm
Use Lead Gen or Website Conversions for leads — never 'Website Visits' (optimizes for clickers, not converters)

_universal.disclaimer: LinkedIn Ads is a B2B precision targeting platform — NOT a general-awareness or B2C channel. Campaigns are built around professional identity (job title, function, seniority, company size, industry). Allow 14-30 days of learning phase before judging performance. Real benchmark is your own historical data + unit economics, not industry averages.

_generic.viabilityNote: LinkedIn viability for this industry depends entirely on whether your buyer is a B2B decision-maker reachable by job title/function. Run the rule of thumb: if you wouldn't pay a recruiter to find this exact person, LinkedIn is probably not your channel.

targetPersonas.guidance: Build three audience segments: primary decision-maker, technical influencer, economic buyer. Layer Job Function + Seniority + Industry + Company Size for precision.

recommendedFormats: Single Image with Lead Gen Form (default workhorse)
_generic.funnelStrategy: TOFU: thought leadership content as Document Ads. MOFU: gated guides via Lead Gen Forms. BOFU: high-intent retargeting + ABM Conversation Ads.
_generic.copyAngle: Test all three frameworks: PAS, BAB, Insight-Led. Pick whichever your audience signals reaction to first.
_generic.abmOpportunity: Evaluate per client. Company Lists are LinkedIn's strongest feature when you can name your accounts.
_generic.audienceSizeNote: Target 50K-300K members for Lead Gen campaigns. Anything smaller leads to inflated CPMs and frequency caps.
_generic.watchOuts: Validate whether your offer truly fits B2B precision targeting before launching. Misalignment is the single most common reason LinkedIn underperforms.

architecture.viabilityNote: LinkedIn is strong for COMMERCIAL architecture. Residential architecture should not run LinkedIn — buyer is on Google/Meta.
recommendedFormats: Document Ad (case studies of completed projects)
architecture.funnelStrategy: TOFU: thought leadership content on commercial design trends. MOFU: case study Document Ads showing finished healthcare/retail projects. BOFU: Lead Gen Form for consultation request, ABM list of regional developers + property managers.
architecture.copyAngle: Insight-Led works best — open with a data point about commercial construction trends, healthcare facility design ROI, or tenant attraction. Avoid 'we design buildings' generic positioning.
architecture.abmOpportunity: High. Build a Company List of every regional developer, property management company, healthcare system, and commercial RE firm in your geography. ABM Conversation Ads to facility directors at named accounts.
architecture.audienceSizeNote: Tight audience — expect 30K-80K when geo-restricted. Lean into ABM company lists for precision.
architecture.watchOuts: Avoid LinkedIn for residential architecture work. Job title alone is unreliable for 'developer' (catches software developers) — always layer with Industry: Real Estate, Construction, or Hospital & Health Care.

commercial-contractor.viabilityNote: Commercial general contractors and construction firms are well-suited. Residential contracting should not run LinkedIn.
recommendedFormats: Single Image (finished hero shots with project specs)
commercial-contractor.funnelStrategy: TOFU: video reels of recent projects + thought leadership on bid strategy. MOFU: Document Ad with full project portfolio. BOFU: ABM list of regional commercial RE developers + facility decision makers.
commercial-contractor.copyAngle: BAB framework — show the before (vacant building, stalled renovation) and after (operational facility, stronger NOI). Lead with timeline + budget delivery, not capabilities lists.
commercial-contractor.abmOpportunity: Very high. Upload all regional commercial RE firms, property managers, and hospital systems as a Company List.
commercial-contractor.audienceSizeNote: Lean toward ABM company lists for precision. Geo-targeted facility-director audiences run 25K-60K.
commercial-contractor.watchOuts: LinkedIn industry taxonomy treats 'Construction' very broadly — pair with Job Function: Real Estate or Operations to filter out tradesmen and field roles when targeting decision makers.

financial-services.viabilityNote: Financial services is one of LinkedIn's strongest verticals — buyers research extensively and are reachable by job function and company size.
recommendedFormats: Lead Gen Form on Single Image
financial-services.funnelStrategy: TOFU: market commentary Document Ads. MOFU: gated white paper Lead Gen Forms. BOFU: book a 30-min planning call with conversion tracking.
financial-services.copyAngle: Insight-Led performs best — open with a market data point or counterintuitive observation. PAS for tax/exit planning offers (clear pain). Avoid generic 'we manage money' messaging.
financial-services.abmOpportunity: High for B2B advisory. ABM company lists of mid-market businesses. For wealth management, less relevant — use job function targeting instead.
financial-services.audienceSizeNote: C-Suite audiences run small (10K-30K geo-bound). Acceptable here because CPL economics support tighter targeting.
financial-services.watchOuts: Compliance review of all ad copy before launch — financial services advertising has strict regulatory requirements. CPL runs at the high end of LinkedIn norms ($90-150) — budget accordingly.

insurance.viabilityNote: Commercial insurance and group benefits are strong fits. Personal/auto insurance should run on Google/Meta, not LinkedIn.
recommendedFormats: Single Image with Lead Gen Form
insurance.funnelStrategy: TOFU: educational content on emerging risks (cyber, EPL, supply chain). MOFU: gated risk assessment Lead Gen Form. BOFU: book quote review or benefits audit.
insurance.copyAngle: PAS — pain points are clear in commercial insurance (claims denials, underinsurance, premium hikes). Lead with a specific risk scenario, not 'comprehensive coverage'.
insurance.abmOpportunity: Strong for commercial lines. Upload regional companies above a revenue threshold as Company Lists.
insurance.audienceSizeNote: Risk Manager titles are limited — pair with Job Function: Operations + company size to broaden viable pool.
insurance.watchOuts: Personal insurance lines do not work on LinkedIn — keep budget for Google/Meta. State licensing must be reflected in geo-targeting.

healthcare.viabilityNote: Healthcare-to-healthcare B2B (medical devices, healthcare software, specialty referrals, practice management) is one of LinkedIn's strongest verticals.

targetPersonas.watchOut: Use Member Skills + Industry rather than Job Title — physician titles vary widely

recommendedFormats: Lead Gen Form for demo requests
healthcare.funnelStrategy: TOFU: clinical thought leadership Document Ads. MOFU: gated outcome data white papers. BOFU: demo or consultation booking.
healthcare.copyAngle: Insight-Led for clinical innovations. PAS for practice operations pain (staffing, RCM, compliance). Avoid generic 'patient care' positioning.
healthcare.abmOpportunity: Very high. Hospital systems, medical group practices, and ASCs are all addressable as Company Lists.
healthcare.audienceSizeNote: Specialty physician audiences are small (5K-25K in many regions) — expect higher CPMs but very high lead value.
healthcare.watchOuts: Clinical claims must be substantiated and HIPAA-aware. CPL runs at the high end ($100-200) given audience precision and competition.

legal-services.viabilityNote: Strong for B2B legal — corporate, employment, M&A, IP, litigation defense. Consumer-facing legal (personal injury, family law, estate) should run Google/Meta.
recommendedFormats: Single Image with Lead Gen Form
legal-services.funnelStrategy: TOFU: legal alerts and regulatory updates as Document Ads. MOFU: gated guides on relevant compliance areas. BOFU: consultation request Lead Gen Forms.
legal-services.copyAngle: Insight-Led for thought leadership. PAS for compliance/litigation pain. Avoid 'we win cases' generics — lead with specific industry expertise.
legal-services.abmOpportunity: Strong. Upload regional companies in target industries above your minimum-fit threshold as Company Lists.
legal-services.audienceSizeNote: General Counsel audiences are limited (10K-30K geo-bound). Layer with company size for broader reach via business decision makers.
legal-services.watchOuts: Bar association advertising rules apply to ad copy. Consumer legal does not work — strictly B2B-focused work justifies LinkedIn spend.

real-estate.viabilityNote: Commercial real estate (CRE) is strong on LinkedIn. Residential is not — keep residential on Google, Meta, and LSA.
recommendedFormats: Single Image with Lead Gen Form
real-estate.funnelStrategy: TOFU: market reports and trend pieces. MOFU: gated submarket analyses. BOFU: tour request Lead Gen Forms.
real-estate.copyAngle: Insight-Led with market data. BAB for relocation/expansion stories. Avoid 'premium space' generic positioning.
real-estate.abmOpportunity: High for tenant rep / corporate RE work. Upload growing companies above target headcount as Company Lists.
real-estate.audienceSizeNote: CRE professionals are tight (15K-40K geo-bound). Tenant rep audiences scale better via company-size + industry layering.
real-estate.watchOuts: Strictly commercial — running residential listings here will burn budget.

commercial-agricultural-electric.viabilityNote: Commercial and agricultural electrical is well-suited for LinkedIn — buyer profile maps cleanly to plant managers, facility directors, and farm operations leads.
recommendedFormats: Document Ad (case studies of elevators, farm builds, PLC integrations)
Single Image with Lead Gen Form
commercial-agricultural-electric.funnelStrategy: TOFU: technical thought leadership on automation, three-phase upgrades, NEC compliance. MOFU: case studies of completed grain elevator / livestock facility projects. BOFU: site visit / quote Lead Gen Form.
commercial-agricultural-electric.copyAngle: PAS — uptime, compliance, and harvest-window pain points are clear. BAB for facility upgrade stories.
commercial-agricultural-electric.abmOpportunity: Very high. Build Company Lists of regional grain cooperatives, dairy ops, food processors, and manufacturers above your minimum facility size.
commercial-agricultural-electric.audienceSizeNote: Agricultural-specific titles are small (5K-15K geo-bound). Pair with Industry: Farming + Dairy + Food Production to broaden.
commercial-agricultural-electric.watchOuts: LinkedIn taxonomy 'Construction' and 'Utilities' don't cleanly capture this work — Industry: Farming + Manufacturing pairing tends to perform better than Industry: Construction.

commercial-plumbing.viabilityNote: Commercial plumbing maps cleanly to LinkedIn — property managers, facility directors, and restaurant operators are reachable by job function.
recommendedFormats: Single Image with Lead Gen Form
Video (response time / large project case studies)
commercial-plumbing.funnelStrategy: TOFU: compliance content (NFPA 99, backflow, grease trap regulations). MOFU: maintenance contract guides. BOFU: contract quote Lead Gen Form.
commercial-plumbing.copyAngle: PAS — compliance failures, emergency downtime, and code violations are sharp pain points. Lead with a specific scenario, not 'commercial plumbing services'.
commercial-plumbing.abmOpportunity: Very high. Upload all regional property management companies, restaurant groups, hospitals, and multi-tenant building owners as a Company List.
commercial-plumbing.audienceSizeNote: Restaurant operations titles run 20K-50K geo-bound. Property managers run larger. Both sustain Lead Gen campaigns at recommended floor.
commercial-plumbing.watchOuts: Residential plumbing should not run LinkedIn. Medical gas certification is a unique B2B angle — call it out for hospital targeting.

interior-design.viabilityNote: ONLY commercial interior design works on LinkedIn. Residential interior design audiences live on Pinterest, Instagram, and Google.
interior-design.funnelStrategy: TOFU: workplace design trend pieces. MOFU: project case study Document Ads. BOFU: consultation Lead Gen Forms.
interior-design.copyAngle: BAB — show the before (dated, dysfunctional space) and after (productive, on-brand environment). Insight-Led works for thought leadership.
interior-design.abmOpportunity: Strong for workplace design. ABM lists of regional growing companies, hotel groups, restaurant operators, healthcare systems.
interior-design.audienceSizeNote: Workplace director / facility director audiences run 20K-60K geo-bound.
interior-design.watchOuts: Do not run residential interior design on LinkedIn under any circumstances. CPL will exceed $200 with poor lead quality.

printing.viabilityNote: Commercial printing maps cleanly to LinkedIn — marketing managers, brand directors, and procurement leads run print programs at most mid-market companies.
recommendedFormats: Single Image with Lead Gen Form
printing.funnelStrategy: TOFU: trends in direct mail / personalization / print ROI. MOFU: print buying guides as gated Lead Gen Forms. BOFU: quote / sample request.
printing.copyAngle: PAS for direct mail (response rates, cost per acquisition vs digital). BAB for brand identity refreshes. Avoid 'quality printing' generic positioning.
printing.abmOpportunity: Very high. Upload regional mid-market companies, associations, schools, and event planners as Company Lists.
printing.audienceSizeNote: Marketing director audiences run 30K-80K geo-bound. Direct mail audiences benefit from Member Skills targeting (Direct Mail, Direct Response Marketing).
printing.watchOuts: Wedding/consumer invitations side does not work on LinkedIn — strictly commercial accounts. Procurement targeting can yield price-shoppers; layer with company size for higher-LTV accounts.

truck-fleet-service.viabilityNote: Fleet maintenance and trucking services map cleanly to LinkedIn — fleet managers, logistics directors, and operations leads run these decisions.
recommendedFormats: Document Ad (uptime case studies, maintenance guides)
Single Image with Lead Gen Form
truck-fleet-service.funnelStrategy: TOFU: uptime / TCO content. MOFU: fleet maintenance contract guides. BOFU: service contract quote Lead Gen Form.
truck-fleet-service.copyAngle: PAS — downtime, DOT violations, and repair-cycle costs are sharp pain points. BAB for uptime improvement stories.
truck-fleet-service.abmOpportunity: High. Upload regional fleet operators and logistics companies above your minimum vehicle count as Company Lists.
truck-fleet-service.audienceSizeNote: Fleet manager audiences run 15K-40K geo-bound. Pair with Industry: Transportation + Logistics + Construction for broader reach.
truck-fleet-service.watchOuts: Consumer truck/RV repair does not work on LinkedIn — strictly fleet/commercial. DOT-regulated work requires compliance review of ad copy.

pressure-washing-landscape-care.viabilityNote: Strong for the COMMERCIAL side — restaurant hood cleaning, commercial pressure washing, commercial landscape contracts. Residential pressure washing and lawn care should run Google/Meta/LSA, not LinkedIn.
recommendedFormats: Document Ad (compliance guides for NFPA 96 hood cleaning)
Single Image with Lead Gen Form
pressure-washing-landscape-care.funnelStrategy: TOFU: compliance content (NFPA 96, health code). MOFU: maintenance contract guides. BOFU: contract quote Lead Gen Form.
pressure-washing-landscape-care.copyAngle: PAS — compliance failures, fire risk (hood cleaning), and curb appeal pain are sharp. Avoid generic 'we clean buildings' positioning.
pressure-washing-landscape-care.abmOpportunity: High for restaurant groups, property management, HOAs, and multi-tenant building owners.
pressure-washing-landscape-care.audienceSizeNote: Restaurant operations and property management audiences run 20K-50K geo-bound. Sustain Lead Gen campaigns at recommended floor.
pressure-washing-landscape-care.watchOuts: Residential side of the business should be excluded entirely from LinkedIn campaigns — keep that budget on Google/Meta/LSA.
